config.ts reads NODE_ENV once, as config.production, for the legal posture: a source the registry marks forbidden (the iaBilet rule) may be refreshed in development, never in production, and the image sets NODE_ENV=production, so the safeguard can't be lost to a deploy that forgets a purpose-named variable. The seed scripts' refusal to wipe a production database reads the same flag.
